description: Source code for the 'tinygettext' library, implementing a gettext replacement that operates directly on .po files, including translation management, plural forms, context handling, and fallback support.

classes.name: tinygettext::Dictionary
classes.description: Manages translation entries, plural forms, context-specific translations, and fallback translations.

methods.name: Dictionary::get_charset
methods.description: Returns the character set used by the dictionary.

methods.name: Dictionary::set_plural_forms
methods.description: Sets the plural forms rules for translation.

methods.name: Dictionary::get_plural_forms
methods.description: Retrieves the current plural forms rules.

methods.name: Dictionary::translate_plural
methods.description: Translates a plural message based on count.

methods.name: Dictionary::translate
methods.description: Translates a message ID to its localized string.

methods.name: Dictionary::translate_ctxt
methods.description: Translates a message ID within a specific context.

methods.name: Dictionary::translate_ctxt_plural
methods.description: Translates a plural message within a specific context.

methods.name: Dictionary::add_translation
methods.description: Adds a translation for a message ID, with overloads for plural and context-specific translations.
